title: Keep Anvil README in English with Anvil branding and compact U+2800 Braille logo
what: README.md must always be written in English, capitalize the project name as Anvil (not lowercase anvil in prose/headings), focus on general overview and harness layers (no changelog/installation), and keep the 3D Braille logo <=61 cols with U+2800 blanks so GitHub renders it without deformation or horizontal scroll.
why: Previous Spanish translation and lowercase naming broke repository conventions, and ASCII spaces or wide Braille art caused deformation and horizontal scrolling on GitHub.
learned: Always match the repository's existing README language (English for Anvil) and branding (Anvil), and use U+2800 Braille blanks within <=61 columns for GitHub-safe Braille art.
author: reactive-end
